title: Money Basics
description: Learn about coins, bills, and how money works

content.introduction: Welcome to Money Basics! In this module, you'll learn all about money - what it is, how we use it, and why it's important.

lessons.title: What is Money?
lessons.content: Money is something we use to buy things we need and want. It comes in different forms like coins and paper bills. Money helps us trade for things we can't make ourselves!

lessons.title: Coins and Bills
lessons.content: Let's learn about different coins: pennies (1¢), nickels (5¢), dimes (10¢), quarters (25¢), and dollar bills ($1). Each one has a different value!

lessons.title: Counting Money
lessons.content: Practice counting coins and bills to make different amounts of money. Start with small amounts and work your way up!

activities.title: Coin Sorting Game
activities.description: Sort coins by type and value

questions.question: Which coin is worth 1 cent?
How many pennies make a nickel?
What is the smallest coin?

title: Business Ideas
description: Discover different types of businesses you can start

content.introduction: Every great business starts with a great idea! Let's explore different types of businesses and learn how to come up with your own business ideas.
objectives: Understand what makes a good business idea

lessons.title: Types of Businesses
lessons.content: There are many different types of businesses: service businesses (like pet care), product businesses (like selling crafts), and food businesses (like lemonade stands).

lessons.title: What Makes a Good Business Idea?
lessons.content: A good business idea solves a problem or meets a need that people have. It should be something you're interested in and can do well.

lessons.title: Finding Your Business Idea
lessons.content: Think about what you're good at, what you enjoy doing, and what problems you could solve for others.

activities.title: Business Idea Generator
activities.description: Use our tool to generate business ideas based on your interests

questions.question: What do you enjoy doing in your free time?

title: Saving & Spending
description: Learn how to save money and spend wisely

content.introduction: Money management is an important skill! Learn the difference between needs and wants, and how to save money for the things you really want.
objectives: Understand the difference between needs and wants

lessons.title: Needs vs Wants
lessons.content: Needs are things we must have to live (like food and clothes), while wants are things we'd like to have (like toys and games).

lessons.title: How to Save Money
lessons.content: Saving money means putting some money aside instead of spending it all. You can save for something special you want to buy later.

lessons.title: Making Smart Choices
lessons.content: Before you spend money, ask yourself: Do I really need this? Can I afford it? Is there something better I could save for?

activities.title: Savings Goal Calculator
activities.description: Calculate how long it will take to save for something you want

questions.question: If you save $5 every week, how long will it take to save $50?

title: Business Math
description: Learn basic math skills for running a business

content.introduction: Math is super important for running a business! Learn how to calculate profits, set prices, and manage your money.
objectives: Learn to calculate profit and loss

lessons.title: Profit and Loss
lessons.content: Profit is what you earn after paying for everything. If you spend more than you earn, that's a loss!

lessons.title: Setting Prices
lessons.content: Your price needs to cover your costs plus give you some profit. Don't forget about your time!

lessons.title: Budgeting Basics
lessons.content: A budget helps you plan how to spend your money. Track what comes in and what goes out!

activities.title: Profit Calculator
activities.description: Calculate profits for different business scenarios

questions.question: If you sell lemonade for $2 and it costs $0.50 to make, what's your profit per cup?

title: Entrepreneurship Basics
description: Learn what it means to be an entrepreneur

content.introduction: Entrepreneurs are people who start their own businesses! Learn about the skills and mindset you need to be successful.

lessons.title: What is an Entrepreneur?
lessons.content: An entrepreneur is someone who starts their own business to solve problems and help people. They're creative, brave, and hardworking!

lessons.title: Young Entrepreneurs
lessons.content: Many kids have started successful businesses! Learn about their stories and what made them successful.

lessons.title: Leadership Skills
lessons.content: Good entrepreneurs are also good leaders. They inspire others and work well in teams.

activities.title: Entrepreneur Challenge
activities.description: Solve real-world problems like an entrepreneur

questions.question: What's the first step in starting a business?

lessons.title: What is Money?
lessons.content: Money is something we use to buy things we need and want. It comes in different forms like coins and paper bills. Money helps us trade for things we can't make ourselves!

lessons.title: Coins and Bills
lessons.content: Let's learn about different coins: pennies (1¢), nickels (5¢), dimes (10¢), quarters (25¢), and dollar bills ($1). Each one has a different value!

lessons.title: Counting Money
lessons.content: Practice counting coins and bills to make different amounts of money. Start with small amounts and work your way up!

title: Saving & Spending
description: Learn how to save money and spend wisely

content.introduction: Money management is an important skill! Learn the difference between needs and wants, and how to save money for the things you really want.
objectives: Understand the difference between needs and wants

lessons.title: Needs vs Wants
lessons.content: Needs are things we must have to live (like food and clothes), while wants are things we'd like to have (like toys and games).

lessons.title: How to Save Money
lessons.content: Saving money means putting some money aside instead of spending it all. You can save for something special you want to buy later.

lessons.title: Making Smart Choices
lessons.content: Before you spend money, ask yourself: Do I really need this? Can I afford it? Is there something better I could save for?

title: Money Basics
description: Learn about coins, bills, and how money works

content.introduction: Welcome to Money Basics! In this module, you'll learn all about money - what it is, how we use it, and why it's important.

lessons.title: What is Money?
lessons.content: Money is something we use to buy things we need and want. It comes in different forms like coins and paper bills. Money helps us trade for things we can't make ourselves!

lessons.title: Coins and Bills
lessons.content: Let's learn about different coins: pennies (1¢), nickels (5¢), dimes (10¢), quarters (25¢), and dollar bills ($1). Each one has a different value!

lessons.title: Counting Money
lessons.content: Practice counting coins and bills to make different amounts of money. Start with small amounts and work your way up!

activities.title: Coin Sorting Game
activities.description: Sort coins by type and value

questions.question: Which coin is worth 1 cent?
How many pennies make a nickel?
What is the smallest coin?

description: Discover different types of businesses you can start

lessons.content: There are many different types of businesses: service businesses (like pet care), product businesses (like selling crafts), and food businesses (like lemonade stands).

lessons.title: What Makes a Good Business Idea?
lessons.content: A good business idea solves a problem or meets a need that people have. It should be something you're interested in and can do well.

lessons.title: Finding Your Business Idea
lessons.content: Think about what you're good at, what you enjoy doing, and what problems you could solve for others.

title: Money Basics
description: Learn about coins, bills, and how money works

content.introduction: Welcome to Money Basics! In this module, you'll learn all about money - what it is, how we use it, and why it's important.

lessons.title: What is Money?
lessons.content: Money is something we use to buy things we need and want. It comes in different forms like coins and paper bills. Money helps us trade for things we can't make ourselves!

lessons.title: Coins and Bills
lessons.content: Let's learn about different coins: pennies (1¢), nickels (5¢), dimes (10¢), quarters (25¢), and dollar bills ($1). Each one has a different value!

lessons.title: Counting Money
lessons.content: Practice counting coins and bills to make different amounts of money. Start with small amounts and work your way up!

activities.title: Coin Sorting Game
activities.description: Sort coins by type and value

questions.question: Which coin is worth 1 cent?
How many pennies make a nickel?
What is the smallest coin?

title: Business Ideas
description: Discover different types of businesses you can start

content.introduction: Every great business starts with a great idea! Let's explore different types of businesses and learn how to come up with your own business ideas.
objectives: Understand what makes a good business idea

lessons.title: Types of Businesses
lessons.content: There are many different types of businesses: service businesses (like pet care), product businesses (like selling crafts), and food businesses (like lemonade stands).

lessons.title: What Makes a Good Business Idea?
lessons.content: A good business idea solves a problem or meets a need that people have. It should be something you're interested in and can do well.

lessons.title: Finding Your Business Idea
lessons.content: Think about what you're good at, what you enjoy doing, and what problems you could solve for others.

title: Saving & Spending
description: Learn how to save money and spend wisely

content.introduction: Money management is an important skill! Learn the difference between needs and wants, and how to save money for the things you really want.
objectives: Understand the difference between needs and wants

lessons.title: Needs vs Wants
lessons.content: Needs are things we must have to live (like food and clothes), while wants are things we'd like to have (like toys and games).

lessons.title: How to Save Money
lessons.content: Saving money means putting some money aside instead of spending it all. You can save for something special you want to buy later.

lessons.title: Making Smart Choices
lessons.content: Before you spend money, ask yourself: Do I really need this? Can I afford it? Is there something better I could save for?

content.introduction: Welcome to Money Basics! In this module, you'll learn all about money - what it is, how we use it, and why it's important.

lessons.title: What is Money?
lessons.content: Money is something we use to buy things we need and want. It comes in different forms like coins and paper bills. Money helps us trade for things we can't make ourselves!

lessons.title: Coins and Bills
lessons.content: Let's learn about different coins: pennies (1¢), nickels (5¢), dimes (10¢), quarters (25¢), and dollar bills ($1). Each one has a different value!

lessons.title: Counting Money
lessons.content: Practice counting coins and bills to make different amounts of money. Start with small amounts and work your way up!

title: Money Basics

content.introduction: Welcome to Money Basics! In this module, you'll learn all about money - what it is, how we use it, and why it's important.

lessons.title: What is Money?
lessons.content: Money is something we use to buy things we need and want. It comes in different forms like coins and paper bills. Money helps us trade for things we can't make ourselves!

lessons.title: Coins and Bills
lessons.content: Let's learn about different coins: pennies (1¢), nickels (5¢), dimes (10¢), quarters (25¢), and dollar bills ($1). Each one has a different value!

lessons.title: Counting Money
lessons.content: Practice counting coins and bills to make different amounts of money. Start with small amounts and work your way up!

lessons.content: There are many different types of businesses: service businesses (like pet care), product businesses (like selling crafts), and food businesses (like lemonade stands).

lessons.content: A good business idea solves a problem or meets a need that people have. It should be something you're interested in and can do well.

description: Learn how to save money and spend wisely

objectives: Understand the difference between needs and wants

lessons.title: Needs vs Wants
lessons.content: Needs are things we must have to live (like food and clothes), while wants are things we'd like to have (like toys and games).

lessons.content: Saving money means putting some money aside instead of spending it all. You can save for something special you want to buy later.

title: Money Basics
description: Learn about coins, bills, and how money works

content.introduction: Welcome to Money Basics! In this module, you'll learn all about money - what it is, how we use it, and why it's important.

lessons.title: What is Money?
lessons.content: Money is something we use to buy things we need and want. It comes in different forms like coins and paper bills. Money helps us trade for things we can't make ourselves!

lessons.title: Coins and Bills
lessons.content: Let's learn about different coins: pennies (1¢), nickels (5¢), dimes (10¢), quarters (25¢), and dollar bills ($1). Each one has a different value!

lessons.title: Counting Money
lessons.content: Practice counting coins and bills to make different amounts of money. Start with small amounts and work your way up!

activities.title: Coin Sorting Game
activities.description: Sort coins by type and value

questions.question: Which coin is worth 1 cent?
How many pennies make a nickel?
What is the smallest coin?

title: Business Ideas
description: Discover different types of businesses you can start

content.introduction: Every great business starts with a great idea! Let's explore different types of businesses and learn how to come up with your own business ideas.
objectives: Understand what makes a good business idea

lessons.title: Types of Businesses
lessons.content: There are many different types of businesses: service businesses (like pet care), product businesses (like selling crafts), and food businesses (like lemonade stands).

lessons.title: What Makes a Good Business Idea?
lessons.content: A good business idea solves a problem or meets a need that people have. It should be something you're interested in and can do well.

lessons.title: Finding Your Business Idea
lessons.content: Think about what you're good at, what you enjoy doing, and what problems you could solve for others.

activities.title: Business Idea Generator
activities.description: Use our tool to generate business ideas based on your interests

questions.question: What do you enjoy doing in your free time?

title: Saving & Spending
description: Learn how to save money and spend wisely

content.introduction: Money management is an important skill! Learn the difference between needs and wants, and how to save money for the things you really want.
objectives: Understand the difference between needs and wants

lessons.title: Needs vs Wants
lessons.content: Needs are things we must have to live (like food and clothes), while wants are things we'd like to have (like toys and games).

lessons.title: How to Save Money
lessons.content: Saving money means putting some money aside instead of spending it all. You can save for something special you want to buy later.

lessons.title: Making Smart Choices
lessons.content: Before you spend money, ask yourself: Do I really need this? Can I afford it? Is there something better I could save for?

activities.title: Savings Goal Calculator
activities.description: Calculate how long it will take to save for something you want

questions.question: If you save $5 every week, how long will it take to save $50?

title: Business Math
description: Learn basic math skills for running a business

content.introduction: Math is super important for running a business! Learn how to calculate profits, set prices, and manage your money.
objectives: Learn to calculate profit and loss

lessons.title: Profit and Loss
lessons.content: Profit is what you earn after paying for everything. If you spend more than you earn, that's a loss!

lessons.title: Setting Prices
lessons.content: Your price needs to cover your costs plus give you some profit. Don't forget about your time!

lessons.title: Budgeting Basics
lessons.content: A budget helps you plan how to spend your money. Track what comes in and what goes out!

activities.title: Profit Calculator
activities.description: Calculate profits for different business scenarios

questions.question: If you sell lemonade for $2 and it costs $0.50 to make, what's your profit per cup?

title: Money Basics
description: Learn about coins, bills, and how money works

content.introduction: Welcome to Money Basics! In this module, you'll learn all about money - what it is, how we use it, and why it's important.

lessons.title: What is Money?
lessons.content: Money is something we use to buy things we need and want. It comes in different forms like coins and paper bills. Money helps us trade for things we can't make ourselves!

lessons.title: Coins and Bills
lessons.content: Let's learn about different coins: pennies (1¢), nickels (5¢), dimes (10¢), quarters (25¢), and dollar bills ($1). Each one has a different value!

lessons.title: Counting Money
lessons.content: Practice counting coins and bills to make different amounts of money. Start with small amounts and work your way up!

activities.title: Coin Sorting Game
activities.description: Sort coins by type and value

questions.question: Which coin is worth 1 cent?
How many pennies make a nickel?
What is the smallest coin?

title: Business Ideas
description: Discover different types of businesses you can start

content.introduction: Every great business starts with a great idea! Let's explore different types of businesses and learn how to come up with your own business ideas.
objectives: Understand what makes a good business idea

lessons.title: Types of Businesses
lessons.content: There are many different types of businesses: service businesses (like pet care), product businesses (like selling crafts), and food businesses (like lemonade stands).

lessons.title: What Makes a Good Business Idea?
lessons.content: A good business idea solves a problem or meets a need that people have. It should be something you're interested in and can do well.

lessons.title: Finding Your Business Idea
lessons.content: Think about what you're good at, what you enjoy doing, and what problems you could solve for others.

activities.title: Business Idea Generator
activities.description: Use our tool to generate business ideas based on your interests

questions.question: What do you enjoy doing in your free time?

title: Saving & Spending
description: Learn how to save money and spend wisely

content.introduction: Money management is an important skill! Learn the difference between needs and wants, and how to save money for the things you really want.
objectives: Understand the difference between needs and wants

lessons.title: Needs vs Wants
lessons.content: Needs are things we must have to live (like food and clothes), while wants are things we'd like to have (like toys and games).

lessons.title: How to Save Money
lessons.content: Saving money means putting some money aside instead of spending it all. You can save for something special you want to buy later.

lessons.title: Making Smart Choices
lessons.content: Before you spend money, ask yourself: Do I really need this? Can I afford it? Is there something better I could save for?

activities.title: Savings Goal Calculator
activities.description: Calculate how long it will take to save for something you want

questions.question: If you save $5 every week, how long will it take to save $50?

title: Business Math
description: Learn basic math skills for running a business

content.introduction: Math is super important for running a business! Learn how to calculate profits, set prices, and manage your money.
objectives: Learn to calculate profit and loss

lessons.title: Profit and Loss
lessons.content: Profit is what you earn after paying for everything. If you spend more than you earn, that's a loss!

lessons.title: Setting Prices
lessons.content: Your price needs to cover your costs plus give you some profit. Don't forget about your time!

lessons.title: Budgeting Basics
lessons.content: A budget helps you plan how to spend your money. Track what comes in and what goes out!

activities.title: Profit Calculator
activities.description: Calculate profits for different business scenarios

questions.question: If you sell lemonade for $2 and it costs $0.50 to make, what's your profit per cup?

title: Entrepreneurship Basics
description: Learn what it means to be an entrepreneur

content.introduction: Entrepreneurs are people who start their own businesses! Learn about the skills and mindset you need to be successful.

lessons.title: What is an Entrepreneur?
lessons.content: An entrepreneur is someone who starts their own business to solve problems and help people. They're creative, brave, and hardworking!

lessons.title: Young Entrepreneurs
lessons.content: Many kids have started successful businesses! Learn about their stories and what made them successful.

lessons.title: Leadership Skills
lessons.content: Good entrepreneurs are also good leaders. They inspire others and work well in teams.

title: Money Basics
description: Learn about coins, bills, and how money works

content.introduction: Welcome to Money Basics! In this module, you'll learn all about money - what it is, how we use it, and why it's important.

lessons.title: What is Money?
lessons.content: Money is something we use to buy things we need and want. It comes in different forms like coins and paper bills. Money helps us trade for things we can't make ourselves!

lessons.title: Coins and Bills
lessons.content: Let's learn about different coins: pennies (1¢), nickels (5¢), dimes (10¢), quarters (25¢), and dollar bills ($1). Each one has a different value!

lessons.title: Counting Money
lessons.content: Practice counting coins and bills to make different amounts of money. Start with small amounts and work your way up!

activities.title: Coin Sorting Game
activities.description: Sort coins by type and value

questions.question: Which coin is worth 1 cent?
How many pennies make a nickel?
What is the smallest coin?

title: Business Ideas
description: Discover different types of businesses you can start

content.introduction: Every great business starts with a great idea! Let's explore different types of businesses and learn how to come up with your own business ideas.
objectives: Understand what makes a good business idea

lessons.title: Types of Businesses
lessons.content: There are many different types of businesses: service businesses (like pet care), product businesses (like selling crafts), and food businesses (like lemonade stands).

lessons.title: What Makes a Good Business Idea?
lessons.content: A good business idea solves a problem or meets a need that people have. It should be something you're interested in and can do well.

lessons.title: Finding Your Business Idea
lessons.content: Think about what you're good at, what you enjoy doing, and what problems you could solve for others.

title: Saving & Spending
description: Learn how to save money and spend wisely

content.introduction: Money management is an important skill! Learn the difference between needs and wants, and how to save money for the things you really want.
objectives: Understand the difference between needs and wants

lessons.title: Needs vs Wants
lessons.content: Needs are things we must have to live (like food and clothes), while wants are things we'd like to have (like toys and games).

lessons.title: How to Save Money
lessons.content: Saving money means putting some money aside instead of spending it all. You can save for something special you want to buy later.

lessons.title: Making Smart Choices
lessons.content: Before you spend money, ask yourself: Do I really need this? Can I afford it? Is there something better I could save for?
